title: Chapter 8 — Section 10
summary: 10. Let no one blaspheme those gods which other cities esteem such; The Apostolical Constitutions, B. II. ch. 26. sect. 31, expound this law of Moses, Exodus 22. 28, "Thou shalt not revile or blasphem

inlines.v: 10. Let no one blaspheme those gods which other cities esteem such; The Apostolical Constitutions, B. II. ch. 26. sect. 31, expound this law of Moses, Exodus 22. 28, "Thou shalt not revile or blaspheme the gods," or magistrates, which is a much more probable exposition than this of Josephus, of heathen gillis, as here, and against Apion, B. II. ch. 3. sect. 31. What book of the law was thus publicly read, see the note on Antiq. B. X. ch. 5. sect. 5, and 1 Esd. 9:8-55. nor may any one steal what belongs to strange temples, nor take away the gifts that are dedicated to any god.
